profile.name: Abdulsamad Abdulsalam
profile.headline:
Behind every great product,
a system that holds.
profile.intro: I build APIs, platforms, and developer tools. My focus is the backend: reliable services, network infrastructure, and the foundations that help teams ship.
profile.about: I’m a backend and platform engineer working across APIs, distributed systems, network infrastructure, and developer tooling. I care about how software behaves beyond the happy path: the data, the queues, the deployment, and the people who maintain it. I can build the frontend too, which helps me carry a product from its foundations to a useful experience.
profile.now: Building Zentramesh, the networking engine behind Netra.ng and Superkonnect.
profile.philosophy: Build fast. Break nothing. Scale smart. Stay curious.

projects.title: Zentramesh
projects.description: Core networking engine powering Netra.ng and Superkonnect. Interfaces with cloud-hosted TP-Link Omada SDN controllers (ER605 routers & EAP 650 APs) to automate user authentication, billing, and bandwidth shaping, serving hundreds of active users and managing millions of NGN in revenue.

projects.title: Goose
projects.description: A type-safe MongoDB ODM for Go, formerly Morm. Built on the official MongoDB driver with Go generics, fluent queries, schema validation, middleware, and transaction support.

projects.title: Netra
projects.description: Powered by Zentramesh, Netra provides seamless captive portal authentication, dynamic voucher generation, and real-time subscription management for high-density internet access networks.

projects.title: Superkonnect
projects.description: Powered by Zentramesh, Superkonnect provides seamless captive portal authentication, dynamic voucher generation, and real-time subscription management for high-density internet access networks.

projects.title: UniDeals
projects.description: A student discount platform for discovering exclusive brand offers and helping partners reach a focused student audience. A product where marketplace workflows, partner data, and a simple redemption experience have to stay dependable.

projects.title: Document Retrieval Microservice
projects.description: An asynchronous Node.js service using RabbitMQ and vector storage to ingest PDF documents, index their contents, and serve context-aware retrieval queries with sub-second response times.

projects.title: High-Frequency Trading Websocket Engine
projects.description: A low-latency real-time market data streaming pipeline built in Rust and Next.js, capable of serving 10,000+ concurrent WebSocket connections with sub-50ms latency.

projects.title: Tonzilla
projects.description: A Telegram mini app for private file sharing, allowing users to securely upload, encrypt, and share files directly within Telegram using TON decentralized storage.

projects.title: Sociallio
projects.description: An automated social media management system featuring scheduled publishing, analytics tracking, and multi-account queue orchestration using Redis and BullMQ.

projects.title: Dehub.io
projects.description: A decentralized video streaming platform leveraging IPFS and Livepeer for censorship-resistant media distribution and direct tokenized creator monetization.

projects.title: Allwebtool
projects.description: A centralized directory and aggregator for developer tools, offering one place to discover, compare, and evaluate useful software services.

experience.desc: Delivered scalable full-stack freelance projects while completing university studies. Currently actively seeking full-time roles, bringing a strong passion for solving complex technical challenges.

Spearheaded end-to-end development of scalable solutions, including an integrated estate security and administration system. Optimized user interfaces to drive marketing activities and elevate user engagement.
Architected a highly scalable marketing system and a complex multi-step form builder. Engineered robust solutions utilizing Next.js, Express.js, PHP, and MySQL with Knex and Objection.js.
Built a robust backend API for a developer-focused social network. Engineered resilient platform infrastructure from the ground up using TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.
Developed essential components for an ambitious e-learning platform, including an online library and a dynamic grant/scholarship system designed to democratize access to education.
